awardCategories.title: Award categories
awardCategories.description: Which kinds of federal awards to pull. Each category is fetched with its own query (the API refuses to mix contract and grant codes in one request), then merged into one dataset.

enumTitles: Contracts (BPA calls, purchase/delivery orders, definitive contracts)
Loans (face value + subsidy cost instead of obligated amount)

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: Earliest award action date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to one year ago. The API has no data before 2007-10-01, so earlier dates are clamped.

endDate.title: End date
endDate.description: Latest award action date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Free-text search across award description, recipient and agency. Multiple keywords are ORed by the API.

agencies.title: Awarding agencies
agencies.description: Exact top-tier awarding agency names as USAspending spells them, e.g. "Department of Energy", "Department of Defense", "National Aeronautics and Space Administration". Abbreviations do not match.

fundingAgencies.title: Funding agencies
fundingAgencies.description: Exact top-tier funding agency names (the agency whose budget actually pays, which can differ from the awarding agency on pass-through grants). Same exact-name rule as Awarding agencies.

recipients.title: Recipients
recipients.description: Free-text recipient name search, e.g. "Lockheed Martin". Matches the same box as USAspending's Advanced Search → Recipient. Multiple values are ORed.

awardIds.title: Award IDs (exact lookup)
awardIds.description: Exact PIID / FAIN / URI values, e.g. "N0001917C0001". When set, this becomes an exclusive lookup: every other filter (keywords, agencies, recipients, states, amounts, date window) is ignored and the full 2007-10-01..today date range is used, so an exact-ID lookup can never be silently hidden by an unrelated filter.

placeOfPerformanceStates.title: Place-of-performance states
placeOfPerformanceStates.description: Two-letter USPS state codes for where the work is performed, e.g. CA, TX.

recipientStates.title: Recipient states
recipientStates.description: Two-letter USPS state codes for the recipient's own address, e.g. NY, VA.

minAwardAmount.title: Minimum award amount (USD)
minAwardAmount.description: Only return awards at or above this obligated amount.

maxAwardAmount.title: Maximum award amount (USD)
maxAwardAmount.description: Only return awards at or below this obligated amount.

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: Ordering of results within each category. Loans are sorted by loan value / issued date, which are their equivalents of amount / start date.

order.title: Sort order
order.description: Whether the sort field runs high-to-low (descending, e.g. biggest awards first) or low-to-high.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Stop after this many awards in total (across all selected categories). You are only charged for awards actually returned.

maxPagesPerCategory.title: Max pages per category
maxPagesPerCategory.description: Safety cap on how deep to paginate each category (100 awards per page).
